entities.name: 32-aa query sequence
observations: 32-aa sequence FSGLEAAIVLIAFVVVAAVFSYVMLGAGFFAT has calculated molecular weight 3281.899 Da, pI 4.05, and GRAVY 2.0562.
Protein analysis exactly matched UniProt P17603 (Methanospirillum hungatei 24 kDa flagellin; 100% identity and coverage; E-value 6.55e-12), but query length is only 32 residues.
Pfam detected archaeal flagellin family PF01917.22 across residues 1–32.

entities.name: UniProt P17603
observations: Reviewed reference annotation identifies this protein as 24 kDa flagellin from Methanospirillum hungatei, a subunit that polymerizes to form archaeal flagellar filaments; annotated localization is archaeal flagellum.
